MotorLimitBlock.description: Limit-block object updated every control tick by mcu_limit_block_update (0x20000370..0x200003A3). Holds two inputs, the selected output, mode bits, differences to the limits and Q15 bounds. Field names are probable, from the decompiled stores.

fields.name: in_a
fields.description: Copy of the word the first pointer argument points to (probably the first limit input).

fields.name: in_b
fields.description: Copy of word 0 of the object at param_1[7] (probably the second limit input).

fields.name: out
fields.description: Block output = param_3 + (bound_x - base_offset). Copied to 0x20000350 and to out_copy (probably the limited value).

fields.name: mode_bits
fields.description: Bits 1 and 2 hold two comparison results (probably which bound was hit). The other bits come from the mode byte at param_1+8.

fields.name: param2
fields.description: Copy of the second argument (probably the position or speed input).

fields.name: param3
fields.description: Copy of the third argument. The function later adds (bound_y - base_offset) to it.

fields.name: delta_b
fields.description: param_2 - param_1[5] (probably the distance to a limit).

fields.name: delta_c
fields.description: param_4 - param_2 (probably the distance to the upper bound).

fields.name: delta_d
fields.description: param_5 - param_2 (probably the distance to the lower bound).

fields.name: bound_x
fields.description: Rounded Q15 product (+0x4000, >> 15) of a gain at param_1 and a distance (probably the upper bound).

fields.name: bound_y
fields.description: Rounded Q15 product of a gain and a distance (probably the lower bound).

fields.name: base_offset
fields.description: Rounded Q15 product of a gain and a distance (probably the base offset subtracted from the output).

fields.name: out_copy
fields.description: Copy of out (probably the value used for the next cycle's comparison).
